name: Nom Nom Edible Co | 200mg Gummies | Cherry Yuzu Energy (4:1 THC:CBD)
description: Introducing "Nom Nom Edible Co's" newest energy booster: our 200mg THC edible infused with the invigorating power of yerba mate. Savor the tantalizing blend of cherry and yuzu, delivering a burst of flavor with each bite. Crafted with a touch of CBG, this edible provides a balanced lift, perfect for fueling your day with sustained vitality and focus. Elevate your experience with Nom Nom Edible Co, where energy meets indulgence in every delicious bite.
